  id = {EDN-85},
  title = {Serving adds MAPIE's offsets itself, and partial requests take the median's price},
  date = {2026-10-20},
  milestone = {M4: Model Deployment},
  topic = {ML System Design, Model Deployment},
  participants = {@lukas2510 decided (\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/137}{issue \#137})},
  decision = {MAPIE's \texttt{ConformalizedQuantileRegressor} calibrates UC2's quantile LightGBM models in the \texttt{train} stage only.
The \texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}basic} bundle stores the three boosters and the two conformity offsets, and \texttt{predict\_\allowbreak{}interval\_\allowbreak{}eur} adds them up with LightGBM alone, so the API image carries no MAPIE.
\texttt{/\allowbreak{}price-\allowbreak{}range} takes its typical price from \texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}basic} when FR-01's required fields are all present, and otherwise from the 50\,\% quantile model (FR-07).},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item MAPIE in the serving runtime: the library computes every interval, but it adds a package to the image NFR-04 caps at 1 GB, for two predictions and an addition.
\item Our own conformalized quantile regression without MAPIE: no dependency anywhere, but we would own the correctness of the calibration.
\item Typical price always from \texttt{lgbm-\allowbreak{}basic}, or always from the 50\,\% model: the first is 98.5\,\% MdAPE off on a make-only request, the second 0.2 to 0.7 pp worse on complete ones.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} The pattern EDN-11 set for SHAP: the statistics stay in a maintained library, and serving replays a constant.
A test shows that the range served from a bundle on disk equals MAPIE's on the same rows to a relative 1e-12.
On the test split the nominal 90\,\% range covers 90.2\,\% of full inputs and 91.0\,\% of P1 requests, so SC-05 passes.},
  ai = {Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI laid out the options for both questions, measured the typical-price ones, and recommended these, which @lukas2510 took.
AI implemented it and checked that MAPIE 1.6 moves each bound by one constant before storing it.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-10-20 on issue \#137: options, measurements, implementation.},
